newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's leasing firm profits down.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's leasing firm profits down.

text.p: Morocco's leasing firm Maroc-Leasing said on Wednesday its net profits for 1996 fell to 15.2 million dirhams ($1.6 million) from 18.1 million in 1995.
Turnover for 1996 stood at 473.7 million dirhams. No comparative figure was available for the year before.
It floated 10 percent of its capital on the Casablanca stock exchange in February last year, at a price of 230 dirhams per share.
Morocco's Societe Nationale d'Investissement and Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique hold respectively 35 and 65 percent of the firm's stock.
Maroc-Leasing last traded at 438 dirhams on Tuesday.
